# truenas_nvmet_namespace (Resource)

Manages an NVMe-oF namespace (the block device behind a subsystem) on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_nvmet_namespace" "disk" {
  subsys_id   = 1
  device_type = "ZVOL"
  device_path = "zvol/tank/vms/vm1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_path` (String) Path of the backing device, e.g. "zvol/tank/vms/vm1".
- `subsys_id` (Number) ID of the NVMe-oF subsystem this namespace belongs to.

### Optional

- `device_type` (String) Backing device type: ZVOL or FILE.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the namespace is enabled.
- `filesize` (Number) Size in bytes of the backing file. Only applicable for FILE device_type.
- `nsid` (Number) Namespace ID within the subsystem. Auto-assigned by TrueNAS when unset. Immutable after creation.

### Read-Only

- `device_nguid` (String) NVMe Globally Unique Identifier for the namespace's backing device.
- `device_uuid` (String) UUID for the namespace's backing device.
- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF namespace ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the namespace's backing device is locked (e.g. an encrypted dataset). Not stabilized with UseStateForUnknown since the server can change this independently of Terraform.
